notes: Verifier K, wave 4. Printed: '[-7]: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your end step, you may search your library for a creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle."' Expectation from the text: at 7 loyalty the -7 leaves Garruk at 0 (to the graveyard) and gives you the emblem; at YOUR end step you may search and you put the chosen creature card (card:1 = Library Beast) onto the battlefield; the sorcery is not a creature card and stays. At the OPPONENT's end step the emblem does not trigger (that end_turn step carries no decisions, so any may-ask would fail the step). 'Opening Draw' is the runner's opening draw.
